title: Brain CT non-contrast
text:
Brain CT (non-enhanced)

Hx) 낙상 후 의식저하. anticoagulation (apixaban) 복용 중.

Findings)
Lt frontoparietal convexity를 따라 crescent-shaped high density lesion 있음, max thickness 약 9 mm. c/w acute SDH.
Rightward midline shift 4 mm.
Lt lateral ventricle mild effacement.
Basal cistern 유지됨.
Skull fracture 없음.
Periventricular WM low density (chronic small vessel ischemic change).

Conclusion)
1. Lt convexity acute SDH (9 mm), midline shift 4 mm.
2. Chronic small vessel ischemic change.

=> 응급의학과 이OO 선생님께 2026-01-22 03:15 구두 보고함.
